pair_encoder.pool: mean of each segment, concatenate 512, Linear 512->128 then LayerNorm
pair_encoder.ranking_frozen_parent: ranking/seed_17.pt:pair_encoder (shared by all five Ranking heads)

Construct.residual_head: 128->32->1 per registered construct; GELU tanh approximation

Ranking.head: standardize query and support 128-vectors using qm/qs; shared bias-free 128->16 projection + tanh; concatenate difference, absolute difference, product and 12 standardized descriptors; 60->16 tanh->1
Ranking.normalizers: qm,qs,dm,ds buffers included in each head
Ranking.prior: BLOSUM62 normalized alignment similarity; residual breaks exact prior ties; higher is better
Ranking.descriptor_aggregation: For equal-length candidate and support peptides: delta = candidate-AA-vector minus support-AA-vector at each position. Concatenate mean(delta) [5], mean(abs(delta)) [5], maximum per-position Euclidean norm [1], mismatch fraction [1]. Unequal lengths unsupported.
Ranking.ranking_order: Descending lexicographic (prior, mean residual over five seeds); per-seed ordering (prior, that seed residual). Convert these orderings to centered ascending midranks before fusion. Exact prior/residual ties remain tied.

gate.input_order: 3 expert normalized mean ranks, 3 standard deviations of normalized seed ranks, 6 context features; experts in stored_gate_order
context: population standard deviation of support similarity
gate.ensemble: Within each candidate pool, ascending centered midrank (tie block zero-based [a,b): (a+b)/(2*N)); mean raw scores then rank; seed rank SD uses ddof=0; average five gate scores and weights
